title: ReproShift: Cross-Version Adaptation of Linux Kernel Fuzzing Crash Reproducers
abstract: arXiv:2611.30655v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable crash reproduction is essential for diagnosing and repairing kernel crashes. Historical crash reproducers preserve concrete bug-triggering knowledge and can be reused for regression testing, bug revalidation, and impact analysis across kernel versions. However, kernel evolution can invalidate these reproducers by changing kernel interfaces, configurations, and execution paths. Migrating them is therefore challenging: the adapted reproducer must identify and modify version-sensitive behavior while preserving the bug-triggering operations and resource dependencies that define the original crash. To address this challenge, we propose ReproShift, an automated framework for cross-version crash reproducer migration by preserving bug-triggering semantics while adapting only version-sensitive behavior. translated_title: ReproShift：Linux内核模糊测试崩溃复现器的跨版本适配
translated_abstract: 可靠的崩溃复现对于诊断和修复内核崩溃至关重要。历史崩溃复现器保存了具体的漏洞触发知识，可被重用于回归测试、漏洞复验以及跨内核版本的影响分析。然而，内核的演进会通过改变内核接口、配置和执行路径而使这些复现器失效。因此，迁移这些复现器极具挑战性：适配后的复现器必须识别并修改版本敏感的行为，同时保留定义原始崩溃的漏洞触发操作和资源依赖。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了ReproShift，一个用于跨版本崩溃复现器迁移的自动化框架，它在保留漏洞触发语义的同时，仅对版本敏感的行为进行适配。给定源崩溃工件、源崩溃复现器和目标内核，ReproShift能够生成一个具有相同（崩溃语义）的迁移后崩溃复现器……
tldr: ReproShift是一个自动化框架，通过保留漏洞触发语义、仅适配版本敏感行为，实现Linux内核模糊测试崩溃复现器在不同内核版本间的自动迁移。
en_tdlr: ReproShift is an automated framework that migrates Linux kernel fuzzing crash reproducers across kernel versions by preserving bug-triggering semantics while adapting only version-sensitive behavior.
